questions.title: Diameter of the Tree
questions.description:
The longest corridor between any two crates in the stack tree is the diameter — the number of NODES on the longest path (a single-node tree has diameter 1). The classic recursion: for every node the longest path through it is height(left) + height(right) + 1; take the maximum over all nodes. You may define helper functions (e.g. height).

The program scaffolding (input reading, TNode class and tree building) is already set up for you. Implement only this function:

    def diameter(root):

root is the root TNode of the crate tree. Return the diameter in nodes.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of values in the level-order serialization.
Line 2: n integers — the tree in level order (-1 marks a missing child).

Output Format:
One line with the diameter.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000
1 <= value <= 1000000
The tree has at least one node.
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= n <= 1000; 1 <= value <= 1000000; -1 marks a missing child; tree non-empty

questions.title: Preorder Fill
questions.description:
The program scaffolding (input reading, TNode class and tree building) is already set up for you. Implement only this function:

    def preorder(root, out):

root is the root TNode of a binary tree (each node has val, left, right) and out is a list you must fill with the node values in PREORDER (root first, then the left subtree, then the right subtree). The harness prints the filled list.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of values in the level-order serialization.
Line 2: n integers — the tree in level order (-1 marks a missing child).

Output Format:
One line with the preorder values, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000
1 <= value <= 1000000
The tree has at least one node.
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= n <= 1000; 1 <= value <= 1000000; -1 marks a missing child; tree non-empty
questions.sourcecode:
import sys

sys.setrecursionlimit(300000)


def read_lines():
    return [ln.strip() for ln in sys.stdin.read().split('\n') if ln.strip() != '']


class TNode:
    def __init__(self, v):
        self.val = v
        self.left = None
        self.right = None


def build_tree(tokens):
    it = iter(tokens)
    first = next(it, -1)
    if first == -1:
        return None
    root = TNode(first)
    q = [root]
    for node in q:
        l = next(it, -1)
        if l != -1:
            node.left = TNode(l)
            q.append(node.left)
        r = next(it, -1)
        if r != -1:
            node.right = TNode(r)
            q.append(node.right)
    return root


def preorder(root, out):
    if root is None:
        return
    out.append(root.val)
    preorder(root.left, out)
    preorder(root.right, out)


def main():
    lines = read_lines()
    root = build_tree(list(map(int, lines[1].split())))
    out = []
    preorder(root, out)
    print(' '.join(map(str, out)))


main()
